no-restricted-syntax.message: Tokens only: don't use Tailwind's stock palette (e.g. `text-amber-600`, `bg-blue-500`). Use a semantic token — bg-warning-subtle / text-warning-subtle-foreground, text-destructive, bg-primary — or a --data-* token for an unordered data category. Colour must mean a state or a category, never decoration. See app/globals.css.

Tokens only: no raw hex colours in components. A literal is invisible to the theme switch and to the print stylesheet. Add a token to app/globals.css and reference it via Tailwind. (Genuinely unavoidable cases — SVG `fill` attributes, <meta theme-color>, canvas — need an eslint-disable-next-line with a comment saying why.)
